name: team_allstars
caption:
IF FIVE OF OUR ALL-STARS WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🦅 Vince Carter = Staraptor: courageously challenges much larger foes. Rookie of the Year in 1999, our first playoffs ever
💡 Chris Bosh = Ampharos: its tail is a beacon for lost people. 5 All-Star games with us
🐕 DeMar DeRozan = Arcanine: admired for its beauty, runs as if on wings. Our all-time leading scorer, 4 All-Star games with us
🐗 Kyle Lowry = Emboar: cares deeply about its friends, masters many moves. 6 straight All-Star games and our first ring
🐉 Scottie Barnes = Haxorus: kind, but relentless defending its territory. Rookie of the Year, All-Star in 2024 and 2026

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

facts.claim: Carter won the 1999 NBA Rookie of the Year Award; he was instrumental in leading the Raptors to their first-ever playoff appearance in 2000
With the Raptors, Bosh became a five-time (5x) NBA All-Star and supplanted Vince Carter as the face and leader of the franchise
DeRozan spent nine seasons with the Raptors (2009-2018), where he became the franchise's all-time leading scorer; All-Star 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018 with Toronto (4x)
Lowry: 6x NBA All-Star (2015-2020, sixth straight in 2019-20), all with Toronto (2012-2021); NBA champion 2019, the Raptors' first title
Barnes: NBA Rookie of the Year (2022), 2x NBA All-Star (2024, 2026)
